decision.reason: Measured source-bound live-memory reduction with preserved exercised behavior supports incremental retention. Fresh same-image throughput medians exceed native WebSocket on these three local workloads, but 100000-session relay RSS remains 15.76x at ready; full parity is not established. CPU costs are reported separately from the throughput and memory acceptance criteria.

integration.scope: Exact tested, profiled, browser-verified source and binary retained. Full parity goal remains open; no deploy/push action.

mechanism: Explicit application writer/input states replace large stored async selection state; a queue-owned waker replaces stored Notify metadata, and same-task inline drain state replaces the local finishing token. Full compiler task and heap owners, not isolated writer sizes, establish memory accounting. No cache causality or throughput benefit is assigned to one component.
